Package com.here.sdk.mapdata.ocm

Class RoadSurfaceMarkingAttributeNames

java.lang.Object
com.here.sdk.mapdata.ocm.RoadSurfaceMarkingAttributeNames
public final class RoadSurfaceMarkingAttributeNames extends Object

List of attribute names for geometry data loaded through MapTileDataSource for MapTileDataLayer.ROAD_SURFACE_MARKING_SYMBOLS data layer.

Note: This is a beta release of this feature and may contain bugs or exhibit unexpected behaviour. Related APIs are subject to change without a deprecation process.
